metadata.article_title: Presumption as to Electronic Signature Certificates

article.title: Presumption as to Electronic Signature Certificates
article.content:
87Presumption as to Electronic Signature Certificates

Section 87 · Part III · Chapter V · Presumptions as to documents
The Court shall presume, unless contrary is proved, that the information listed in an Electronic Signature Certificate is correct, except for information specified as subscriber information which has not been verified, if the certificate was accepted by the subscriber.
